text:
rachel_cs: Heads up — Newton Analytics onboarding just jumped overnight, token burn ~3.6x. Main culprit appears to be dense embedding calls from their nightly enrichment. Need a quick safety plan and a one-line QBR bullet.
tom_finops: Oof. Can someone grab route split + a 7-day projection if this persists?
eli_se: Quick console pull: /v1/embeddings = 82% of tokens; current ~1.9M tokens/day -> ~13.3M over 7d. Looks like their full re-index with no batching.
rachel_cs: Immediate asks: 1) temporary credit buffer & alerts, 2) soft throttle on embeddings route, 3) flip enrichment to incremental/delta if possible, 4) schedule 30-min enablement tomorrow.
tom_finops: I recommend 20% buffer; alerts at 70% and 90% of the buffer. I'll compute token->$ delta for the QBR line.
maya_enable: I can run enablement: cover batching, dedupe, TTLs, and using smaller embed model for bulk ops. Morning PT works.
eli_se: Quick mitigation plan in console: set soft cap /v1/embeddings -> 800k tokens/day; enable short TTL caching for recent vectors; flag enrichment job to run in delta mode. Implementing now.
alerts-bot: Created alert "newton-embed-buffer-70-90" (ID: AB-3311). Conditions: usage >=70% of buffer -> notify; 90% -> escalate to oncall.
alerts-bot: Playbook suggestion:
```
1) add 20% credit buffer to account
2) set soft cap: /v1/embeddings = 800k tokens/day
3) enable incremental/delta uploads for enrichment
4) schedule enablement + follow-up in 24h
```
rachel_cs: Please draft one-line QBR sentence: root cause + mitigation + next step. Keep it crisp.
eli_se: Draft: "Root cause: full re-index produced dense embedding calls; Mitigation: incremental enrich + soft cap + caching; Next: monitor 24h and remove renewal flag if stable."
tom_finops: I'll flesh out numbers for the slide (projected tokens/day post-mitigation ~0.55M, token reduction and $ delta). Buffer provisioned and alerts active.
maya_enable: I'll record the session and attach a 1-page playbook with code snippets for incremental embeddings and batching configs.
rachel_cs: Owners: tom_finops -> cushion & slide, eli_se -> caps & pipeline change (in progress), maya_enable -> enablement. I'll reassess renewal risk after 24h. (reacted :thumbsup:)
eli_se: Implemented caps and switched enrichment to delta mode; monitoring dashboard looks stable so far.
alerts-bot: Follow-up reminder set for 24h (3311225933).
rachel_cs: Thanks team. If metrics hold we'll include the playbook in the QBR packet and clear the renewal flag.
